subject: How to obtain the "other" non-CpG and non-shore regions

messages.author: b1a9c31df127dba3
messages.subject: How to obtain the "other" non-CpG and non-shore regions
parts:
Hi, 

I have done the following to obtain methylation region counts in the regions shown: 

objsDB_exons <- regionCounts(objsDB,gene.obj$exons)
objsDB_introns <- regionCounts(objsDB,gene.obj$introns)
objsDB_promoters <- (objsDB,gene.obj$promoters)
objsDB_TSSes <- (objsDB,gene.obj$TSSes)
objsDB_CpGi <- (objsDB,cpg.obj$CpGi)
objsDB_shores <- (objsDB,cpg.obj$shores)

but I do not know how to get the region counts areas which are not not CpGi or shores. I think this area is described in the manual as "other". Do you know how I could do this?

Kind regards, 
Teena

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] How to obtain the "other" non-CpG and non-shore regions
parts:
Other areas that do not have an annotation such as CpGi, exon, intron etc. will be quite large and you generally do not want to summarize methylation levels on such large regions. My advice is to create segments of genome that does not have such annotations using GenomicRanges functions (see manual or their help pages) as Granges objects and feed that into regionCounts. gene.obj$exons etc. are GRanges objects containing locations of annotations. 

Best,
Altuna
